metaDescription: senior dog vaccine schedule: timing table, what to do if a dose is late, and reminders before boosters are due.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This senior dog plan sequences doses against comorbidity timing, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your dog.

Milestone labels on the senior dog table (Annual wellness visit; Legal interval; Discuss with vet) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished senior dog puppy series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with anesthesia-adjacent visits or boarding still requires proof, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the core adult booster so one reminder system owns the senior dog week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed senior dog dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this dog scenario.
Until the senior dog series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches comorbidity timing, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a senior dog make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next core adult booster due date so the same senior dog miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this senior dog vaccine schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual dog.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this senior dog schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to comorbidity timing, and reset reminders as soon as the next senior dog due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with core adult booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that senior dog booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
